articles.title: OpenAI says 10,000 AI agents solved a $1 million math problem. Now mathematicians are fighting
articles.snippet: An internal model more powerful than GPT-6 Astra produced a proposed solution to one of mathematics’ seven Millennium Prize Problems, though questions are emerging over how independently it got there.

articles.title: What could happen if the CLARITY Act fails to pass in 2026
articles.snippet: The US Senate has a limited window to pass a crypto market structure bill, but if it were to fail, the legislation could be completely remade or scrapped under Democrats in 2027.

articles.title: Silvergate ex-CEO blames Biden pressure for bank’s 2023 wind-down
articles.snippet: Alan Lane said a “coordinated attack” by the Biden administration made Silvergate’s continued operation untenable and prompted its liquidation.

articles.title: Franklin Templeton digital asset veteran takes helm at StablecoinX
articles.snippet: Former Franklin Templeton digital asset executive Christopher Jensen will lead StablecoinX, the largest corporate holder of Ethena’s ENA token.

articles.title: Crypto, Banks Take Clarity Act Lobbying Fight to Senators' Home States
articles.snippet: Crypto advocates and community bankers are targeting lawmakers in their home states as the Senate prepares for a September 15 procedural vote.
